title: ARA MANUFACTURING COMPANY: AIR CONDITIONER:MOTOR:FAN (2,021 affected)
summary: THERE IS A POSSIBLE DEFECT IN THE BLOWER ASSEMBLY AND THE ELECTRICAL WIRING IN THE BLOWER OF THE AIR CONDITIONING UNIT. A SHORT CIRCUIT MAY OCCUR IN THE BLOWER ASSEMBLY.

title: PETERBILT MOTOR COMPANY: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:AIR SUPPLY SYSTEM (12 affected)
summary: SHOULD AN ICE BLOCKAGE OCCUR BETWEEN THE AIR DRYER AND THE WET TANK DURING EXTREMELY COLD WEATHER CONDITIONS, THE PRESSURE BETWEEN THE COMPRESSOR AND THE LINE BLOCKAGE WOULD BUILD UP AND COULD LEAD TO A VIOLENT EXPLOSION.

title: AM GENERAL LLC: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT SPINDLE:KNUCKLE:STEER (3,227 affected)
summary: THE FRONT WHEEL SPINDLE MAY DEVELOP CRACKS AND EVENTUALLY FRACTURE COMPLETELY.

title: redundant PREVOST CAR, INC. Inactive: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:ALTERNATOR:GENERATOR (306 affected)
summary: INSULATION OF THE ALTERNATOR AND POST WIRES ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES IS INSUFFICIENT; CORROSION MAY DEVELOP DUE TO CONTACT WITH SALT AND SAND USED IN SNOW AND ICE REMOVAL. CORROSION COULD LEAD TO AN ELECTRICAL SHORT BETWEEN THE ALTERNATOR BODY AND POST.

title: EL DORADO R.V. INC.: STRUCTURE:FRAME AND MEMBERS(GIVE SIDE/END) (233 affected)
summary: THE MOUNTING OF THE CROSSMEMBER MAY BE INSUFFICIENT. CROSSMEMBERS ARE MOUNTED TO A SHIM PIECE OF SQUARE TUBING AND THEN THIS ENTIRE STRUCTURE IS MOUNTED TO THE FRAME. THE SMALL SHIM PIECE COULD BECOME DETACHED FROM THE CROSSMEMBER WHICH WOULD ALLOW THE BODY TO MOVE DOWN TWO INCHES. THIS MOVEMENT COULD PUNCTURE THE FUEL TANK.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:FLEXIBLE (189 affected)
summary: SOME OF THE INVOLVED VEHICLES CONTAIN INCORRECT ACCELERATOR CABLE BRACKETS. THIS COULD ALLOW THE CRUISE CONTROL SERVO ROD TO BIND ON THE ACCELERATOR CABLE BRACKET.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: EXHAUST GAS RECIRCULATION VALVE (EGR VALVE) (2,070 affected)
summary: THE EGR VALVE ASSEMBLY MAY DEVELOP CRACKS AT THE WELDED JOINT BETWEEN THE VALVE AND THE VALVE SHAFT. CRACKS MAY ENLARGE WITH CONTINUED USE AND THE VALVE COULD SEPARATE FROM THE SHAFT.

title: TRANSPORTATION MFG. CORP.: STEERING:LINKAGES:LINK:DRAG:CONNECTION (19 affected)
summary: SOME OF THE INVOLVED VEHICLES CONTAIN DEFECTIVE CAPSCREWS IN THE TWO DRAG LINK CLAMPS. THESE CAPSCREWS CONTAIN QUENCH CRACKS WHICH, OVER A PERIOD OF TIME, MAY CAUSE THEM TO BREAK.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): BRAKES:FLUID:HYDRAULIC (FLUID CONTAMINATION/WRONG (69 affected)
summary: THE BRAKE HYDRAULIC SYSTEM BAY BE EQUIPPED WITH BRAKE FLUID CONTAINING AN EXCESS OF WATER.

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: STEERING:LINKAGES:LINK:DRAG:CONNECTION (182 affected)
summary: THE DRAG LING CLAMPS MAY CONTAIN DEFECTIVE CAPSCREWS. THESE CAPSCREWS MAY CONTAIN CRACKS WHICH COULD EVENTUALLY LEAD TO CAPSCREW FAILURE.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES (45 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED TIRES DO NOT CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 119, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES FOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS". THESE TIRES MAY DEVELOP A SEPARATION IN THE SHOULDER AREA. THIS CONDITION WILL CAUSE A VIBRATION WHEN THE TIRE IS IN USE. IF THE VIBRATION IS IGNORED OR THE SEPARATION IS NOT DETECTED, CONTINUED USE MAY CAUSE THE TIRE TO FAIL LOSING THE INFLATING AIR.

title: GRUMMAN FLXIBLE CORP.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE (89 affected)
summary: THE SECTION THAT CARRIES THE POWER CABLES FROM THE BATTERIES TO THE ENGINE (CALLED THE "HAT" SECTION) COULD FRACTURE CAUSING THE MAIN POWER CABLE TO CHAFE.

title: IVECO TRUCK OF N.A., INC.: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:HYDROBOOST UNIT (42 affected)
summary: THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE BOOSTER MAY NOT BE PROPERLY SECURED DUE TO THE OMISSION OF A NECESSARY SUPPORTING BRACKET IN THE PROCESS OF POWER STEERING INSTALLATION. THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE LINE COULD BE SUBJECT TO FAILURE DUE TO RESULTING FATIGUE.
